scope: Authoring geometry for frontal straight wall runs at native scale; not collision tuning
limits: Intervals use an exclusive right endpoint and describe the main face, not decorative bolts, silhouette shadows or collision.
Match bottom anchors; preserve native dimensions. Tiled canvas width includes transparent padding and is not the repeat pitch.
Ordered mixed-material pitches differ because exported padding is asymmetric.
Keep authored doorway gaps. Fill solid runs to their existing wall boundaries; never move collision or place a bridge across a gate opening.
Corners and shutter joins need their own inspected geometry; do not rotate a frontal panel to invent a side wall.
